## Activity

During August 2024, East City Eye Clinic recorded 19 captures. Activity proceeded in line with the expected session arrangements, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The available activity record indicates that the clinic continued to provide a consistent capture service during the month.

## Image quality

Image quality was generally acceptable. Graders identified 1 ungradable image set, representing 5.3 per cent of captures. This result should be monitored through routine review of capture technique and image adequacy. Any recurring issues can be addressed through the usual feedback and support arrangements.

## Grading

A total of 5 results were graded referable. The median grading wait was 3 days. This provides an overall indication of the time from capture to grading during August 2024. Results should continue to be reviewed through routine site monitoring, with attention to both image quality and grading turnaround.
